title: Synthesis and Activity Evaluation of All-Hydrocarbon Stapled Peptides with Improved Anti-Inflammatory Efficacy via the NF-kappaB Signaling Pathway and Attenuated Cytotoxicity.
authors: Chen, Tingting; Huang, Haolin; Cui, Yaowen; Cai, Jinlong; Peng, Tao; Peng, Ruiyun; Wang, Lin; Xu, Jing; Liu, Shuchen; Zhang, Shouguo
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子对接和MD模拟研究订书肽与NF-kappaB蛋白的相互作用以抗炎，虽涉及蛋白-肽对接和MD，但对象为蛋白-肽而非蛋白-DNA互作，且NF-kappaB为转录因子但未聚焦其DNA结合，方法可迁移性有限。
abstract: Discovering effective anti-inflammatory peptides targeting the NF-kappaB pathway is a critical research priority. Herein, a docking study was carried out to screen 25 original linear peptides. Next, 44 novel stapled peptides via the all-hydrocarbon cross-linking strategy were designed and synthesized. 75%-80% stapled peptides displayed reduced cytotoxicity and improved anti-inflammatory activity over the original peptides in vitro. Compared with Dex, s-12s significantly inhibited the expression of proinflammatory mediators in vitro and in vivo. Notably, s-12s also protected mice from LPS-induced mortality and acute organ injury. Mechanistically, s-12s reduced LPS-induced activation of the NF-kappaB pathway. Moreover, surface plasmon resonance and MD simulations have determined the possibility of NF-kappaB as a target for s-12s. Therefore, s-12s could be used as a promising therapeutic candidate for inflammatory disorders. Meanwhile, these results have proven that the all-hydrocarbon stapling of anti-inflammatory peptides was a feasible approach for the future development of anti-inflammatory therapeutics.
abstract_zh: 发现靶向NF-kappaB通路的高效抗炎肽是研究的关键优先事项。在此，进行了对接研究以筛选25种原始线性肽。接下来，设计并合成了44种通过全烃交联策略的新型钉合肽。75%-80%的钉合肽在体外显示出较原始肽降低的细胞毒性和增强的抗炎活性。与地塞米松（Dex）相比，s-12s在体外和体内均显著抑制了促炎介质的表达。值得注意的是，s-12s还保护小鼠免受脂多糖（LPS）诱导的死亡和急性器官损伤。机制上，s-12s减少了LPS诱导的NF-kappaB通路激活。此外，表面等离子体共振和分子动力学模拟确定了NF-kappaB作为s-12s靶点的可能性。因此，s-12s可作为炎症性疾病的有前景治疗候选物。同时，这些结果证明，抗炎肽的全烃钉合是未来开发抗炎治疗药物的可行方法。
